text:
elena_pm: quick sync — we need to pick the minimum viable contract for launch: what absolutely must be in MVP vs what we defer to v1. customer legal wants SSO + per-tenant audit logs for pilot, but engineering bandwidth is tight. thoughts?

mike_eng: +1 on prioritizing SSO for pilot customers only (sso-v1). full multi-tenant audit retention can be v1.

raj_data: we have telemetry showing 3 pilot tenants will rely on per-tenant logs for compliance checks. if we delay, risk = blocked pilot for 2/3.

sana_design: from UX POV, partial SSO (idp-first flow for invited tenants) is doable. we should avoid adding admin console pages in MVP. keep auth flow inline. :ok_hand:

julie_fe: engineering risk: admin console + log viewer is ~3 wks. inline SSO + email fallback is ~4 days.

drew_eng: can we ship SSO + short-term log export instead of full viewer? e.g. deliver logs as a CSV/JSON export to customer S3. that drops UI work and satisfies compliance for pilot.

elena_pm: that sounds promising. drafted proposal:
- MVP: SSO (IdP), inline auth UX, log export to S3 (pilot-only), visibility via support channel
- v1: tenant admin console, long-term retention, per-route audit filters

mike_eng: implementation notes: need KMS for S3 encryption and a retention flag. backend ETA 2 sprints for export + automation.

raj_data: we should gate export with a simple schema. sample payload:```json
{ "tenant_id": "t-123", "event": "prompt_call", "ts": 1733333000, "tokens": 42 }
```
This keeps downstream parsing simple.

sana_design: will mock the IdP flow and the export settings page (read-only in MVP) by EOD Friday.

julie_fe: I'll scope the inline SSO widgets and email fallback. estimate: 3 dev-days + 1 test-day.

drew_eng: one more constraint — Dedicated customers expect SLA docs. we should include a note in pilot docs: "MVP pilot includes SSO and log exports; no admin UI; SLA applies to inference but not to export latency."

elena_pm: agreed. action items:
- @sana_design: upload mocks (due Fri)
- @julie_fe + @mike_eng: finalize infra + FE plan (due Tue)
- @raj_data: finalize export schema and sample consumer (due Tue)
- @drew_eng: add SLA caveat to docs (due Wed)

pm-bot: Reminder: weekly PM sync in #product on Thursday 10:30am.

elena_pm: thanks team — if no blockers by EOD Tuesday we'll lock MVP scope and update the roadmap. :thumbsup:
